messages.subject: what is an independent record?
parts:
Dear Group

Thanks for all the contributions. Thanks Juergen; I do appreciate the tools provided in camtrapR.  

I am far from clear as to what is an independent record. I understand the idea but how are we defining it with real data? I have not seen a justification for the arbitrary time durations usually nominated.  We looked at our data and empirically we can show that as you increase the time interval between selected images things stabilise. For example, apparently-random fluctuations in the diel activity reduce and a smooth cyclic pattern emerges suggesting that closely repeated records are noise, just replicates. Are these non-independent records?  Has anyone seen a review of this issue?

Regards
David
